notable_absence.finding: This page is a pure grammar reference - a full EBNF breakdown of the SELECT statement's clauses (WITH/SELECT/FROM/JOIN/NEST/UNNEST/LET/WHERE/GROUP BY/WINDOW/ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET), each with a syntax-diagram image and no prose. It has no Purpose, Prerequisites, or Authorization section at all - unlike selectclause.md and selectintro.md, which cover overlapping ground but add a credential-type/privilege table. Concepts/relations kept minimal per batch guidance for thin/reference pages; the individual sub-clause productions (from-clause, join-clause, nest-clause, etc.) are not separately minted here since they are internal grammar nodes rather than independently-referenced concepts, and most already have their own dedicated pages elsewhere in n1ql-language-reference/ outside this batch.
